valuation.market_cap_source: AH Note published stock payload, based on prior screening snapshot; normalized to CNY, as-of 2026-07-24 for this batch input.

items: Cash and bank balances RMB823.786m, including restricted cash RMB0.002m and pledged deposits RMB0.100m. Detachable cash uses 0.65 haircut because the annual report does not split parent/offshore/PRC subsidiary cash.
assets.interpretation: Cash is the dominant asset, but not all consolidated cash can be treated as immediately distributable at holding-company level.

items: Trade receivables RMB114.351m net of RMB78.604m allowance.
Due from related companies RMB28.836m net of impairment.
Prepayments and other receivables RMB43.087m plus small inventories, PPE, intangibles and goodwill in the prior research classification.
assets.interpretation: These assets are tied to property service billing, advances and operations; they are not deducted from market cap as surplus cash.
Small, illiquid or operating-related investments; not treated as detachable cash.

items: Mainly deferred tax and residual accounting assets after classifying funds, operating and investment assets.
assets.interpretation: No separate liquidation value is used in the earnback calculation.

liabilities.interpretation: There is no financing debt offset against cash.

items: Receipts on behalf of customers for utilities RMB23.239m.
Other operating accruals and payables from the annual report classification.
liabilities.interpretation: Contract liabilities and utility collections are real service or pass-through obligations; the cash analysis keeps them inside the business rather than treating them as removable cash.

items: Tax payable and deferred tax liabilities.
liabilities.interpretation: Tax obligations are retained; they are not financing debt.

owner_earnback.interpretation: Under the control-owner lens, market cap of RMB392.0m less discounted detachable net cash of RMB363.9m leaves an operating business price of RMB28.1m. Against discounted sustainable cash profit of RMB57.0m, earnback is about 0.49 years; the result is highly sensitive to the 0.65 cash haircut and receivable loss assumptions.

cash_breakdown.reason: Consolidated cash, after excluding restricted cash and pledged deposits, discounted for undisclosed cash location and PRC/offshore distribution constraints.
Advance receipts from property management contracts are operating obligations.
Pass-through customer utility collections are not surplus cash.

profit_adjustments.reason: 2023-2025 parent net profit was RMB101.863m, RMB81.549m and RMB79.418m; midpoint anchors sustainable profitability below the 2023 high.

profit_adjustments.item: Exclude after-tax bank interest on detachable cash
profit_adjustments.reason: Cash principal is deducted from market cap, so related interest is removed to avoid double counting.
0.75 haircut after interest adjustment reflects 2025 receivable impairment, related-party exposure and cash remittance uncertainty.

dividend.forecast_basis: 2025 annual report did not propose a final dividend and prior research found no cash distribution to use as a normalized payout; forecast is set to zero rather than assuming a future payout from cash holdings.

history.basis: No final dividend proposed for the year ended 31 December 2025.

business.one_line: 领悦服务集团在中国内地提供物业管理、面向非业主的开发商相关增值服务和社区增值服务，2025 年收入九成以上来自基础物业管理。
business.main_business: 2025 年收入 RMB664.471m，其中物业管理服务 RMB619.128m、占 93.2%；非业主增值服务 RMB14.859m、占 2.2%；社区增值服务 RMB30.484m、占 4.6%。全部外部收入来自中国内地。
business.profit_source: 利润主要来自存量住宅和非住宅项目的物业管理费，成本端是现场人员、外包、耗材、维修维护等服务成本；2025 年毛利率 30.6%，但贸易应收减值 RMB56.838m 吞掉了大部分毛利之后的利润。
business.business_model: 轻资产服务模式，主要靠在管项目持续收费和成本控制形成现金流，资本开支很低；但收款质量、关联地产项目来源和预收服务义务决定利润能否转成可分配现金。
business.industry_position: 公司区域和规模不属于可单独定价的全国龙头；2025 年在管面积 31.626m 平方米基本持平，合同面积 34.062m 平方米下降 7.5%，增长弱于行业存量盘子，开发商相关增值服务已明显收缩。

risks.evidence: Annual report only discloses consolidated cash and notes PRC dividend withholding tax; no parent/offshore/PRC cash split is available.
risks.interpretation: The 0.65 cash haircut is a judgment, not a directly observable fact. Lower remittable cash would raise the operating business price materially.

risks.evidence: 2025 trade receivable impairment was RMB56.838m and allowance reached RMB78.604m against gross trade receivables of RMB192.955m.
risks.interpretation: For a property management fee model, this level of expected credit loss is a real cash-profit risk.

risks.evidence: Leading Holdings Group contributed RMB73.427m, 11.1% of 2025 revenue; related project sources remain important to managed-area quality.
risks.interpretation: Developer weakness can affect new projects, value-added services and related-party receivable quality.

risks.evidence: Non-property-owner value-added service revenue fell 33.6% and community value-added service revenue fell 40.1% in 2025.
risks.interpretation: These lines are small in revenue share, but continued decline limits growth and can reduce higher-margin optional profit.

evidence.claim: 2025 revenue, gross profit, parent net profit and cash flow figures are from Annual Report 2025 / annual fact pack, stated in RMB absolute yuan after converting from RMB'000.
Cash and bank balances were RMB823.786m, with restricted cash RMB0.002m and pledged deposits RMB0.100m.
evidence.source: Annual Report 2025 note 20 Cash and cash equivalents

evidence.claim: The group had no interest-bearing borrowings at 31 December 2025.
evidence.source: Annual Report 2025 Management Discussion and Analysis

evidence.claim: Trade receivable impairment was RMB56.838m in 2025 and trade receivables were RMB114.351m net of RMB78.604m allowance.
Market cap RMB392.0m and PE 4.94 use the batch input payload as of 2026-07-24, normalized to CNY.
Discounted net cash and discounted cash profit reuse the prior owner-earnback reasoning embedded in the existing stock research result, but are recalculated into the current protocol formula fields.

limitations: Market cap was not refreshed in real time; it uses the 2026-07-24 batch input snapshot normalized to CNY.
Annual report does not disclose cash split by listed parent, offshore holding vehicles and PRC operating subsidiaries; discounted net cash uses a 0.65 haircut judgment.
Maintenance capex is not separately disclosed; total PPE and intangible purchases are used as a conservative proxy.
Future related-party framework renewals and project delivery quality cannot be confirmed from the 2025 annual report.
